title: PCEP: Updated support to RFC 8664.
description:
Updated support to RFC 8664 from draft-ietf-pce-segment-routing-08 (current support). SR-PCE CAPABILITY Sub-TLV has been added. SR-ERO subobject updated to RFC version: change ST to NT and, NAI of type NT=6 decoding added, updated flag values to official IANA values. Updated errors of Type 10 according to IANA assigned values and numbers.
The old deprecated TLV is maintained for compatibility with old implementations. Attched a capture of the open messages with the new format and the deprecated one from a Cisco router.
